body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates documentation to reflect the actual protocol count in the ObjectStack specification repository. The PR claims to update from 70 to 109 protocols and adds a comprehensive package reference covering all 12 packages in the monorepo.

**Changes:**
- Updated protocol count references from 70 to 109 across multiple documentation files
- Added detailed package reference documentation (packages.mdx) covering 9 core packages and 3 plugin packages
- Expanded protocol category listings with newly documented protocols
- Added packages, hub, integration, auth, and shared to navigation

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/references/quick-reference.mdx | Updated protocol counts and added comprehensive protocol tables for all categories |
| content/docs/references/protocol-map.mdx | Updated architecture diagram with corrected protocol layer counts |
| content/docs/references/packages.mdx | New comprehensive package reference with dependency graph and installation guides |
| content/docs/references/meta.json | Added new pages to navigation structure |
| content/docs/references/index.mdx | Updated protocol counts and expanded category documentation |
| README.md | Updated protocol count reference in main README |
</details>
The API Protocol count should be 14, not 13. There are 14 API protocol files in packages/spec/src/api/.

The System Protocol count should be 28, not 39. There are only 28 system protocol files in packages/spec/src/system/.
```suggestion
| [System Protocol](#system-protocol) | 28 | Runtime environment and platform capabilities (ObjectOS) |
```
The API Protocol count should be 14, not 13. There are 14 API protocol files in packages/spec/src/api/.

This entry is incorrect. There is no connector.zod.ts in packages/spec/src/automation/. The Connector protocol belongs in the Integration category. This table is missing the Trigger Registry protocol (trigger-registry.zod.ts) which is actually in the automation directory. Replace this row with Trigger Registry instead.
```suggestion
| **[Trigger Registry](./automation/trigger-registry)** | `trigger-registry.zod.ts` | TriggerRegistry | Event-driven automation registry |
```

The System Protocol count is incorrect. There are actually 28 system protocols in packages/spec/src/system/, not 39. This overcount of 11 protocols combined with the API undercount explains why the total still adds to 109, but the individual category counts are wrong.
```suggestion
## System Protocol (28 protocols)
```
The System Protocol count should be 28, not 39. Verify actual protocol files in packages/spec/src/system/.

The API Protocol count is incorrect. There are actually 14 API protocols in packages/spec/src/api/, not 13. The protocols are: batch, contract, discovery, endpoint, errors, graphql, http-cache, odata, protocol, realtime, rest-server, router, view-storage, and websocket.
```suggestion
## API Protocol (14 protocols)
```
